findings.cause: PostDominators deliberately rejects reachable blocks without a real exit path. Recovery drops that result to None, then requires post-dominance for branch joins and multi-exit loop follows. Divergent arms lack an alternative region-recovery route.
findings.recommended_fix_target: Builder::region branch/follow fallback when post-dominance is unavailable; preserve the finite-exit-path contract of PostDominators.

findings.model_relation: The prior six-pair Quint trial did not contain these mixed terminating/divergent shapes. Its finite result remains scoped to those pairs.
